method: Seven English previews use built-in image_gen text-localization. NOSEK RST uses the owner-provided original English screenshot. Selected images are exported as 1200 px and 720 px WebP files.
scope: English pages only. Proper brand names stay unchanged. Portraits, icons and already-English stock photos remain shared. These assets are localized portfolio previews, not evidence of English support on linked client sites.

assets.prompt: Use case: text-localization. Image 1 is the edit target: a real website screenshot for an English-language portfolio. Translate only the Slovak interface text to natural US English. Preserve the screenshot's exact composition, aspect ratio, photograph, people and their identities/faces/hands/pose, lighting, dark overlay, colors, typography style, logo MDFOTO, and every non-text detail. No redesign, no new objects, no watermarks. Keep English text in the same positions, with faithful sizes and line wrapping adjusted only to fit. Output one complete screenshot at the original approximately 1200 x 897 aspect ratio, edge to edge, not in a device frame. Exact replacement copy: nav HOME | NEWBORNS | FAMILIES & CHILDREN | MATERNITY | ABOUT ME | PRICING | CONTACT | SERVICES. Small eyebrow 'NITRA & SURROUNDING AREA'. Main heading 'Nitra photographer — memories that never lose their value' across three lines matching the original serif heading. Description 'Natural newborn, family, and maternity photography in Nitra — a relaxed atmosphere, clear guidance, and photos you will love.' Buttons 'CHECK AVAILABILITY' and 'VIEW PACKAGES'. Replace all remaining ordinary Slovak interface words with English. Keep MDFOTO and proper names unchanged. The original photograph must remain visually identical; only lettering changes.
